source: segmentation (Blender simulation with background replaced by white)
units: pixels (x right, y down) and seconds; no metric scale

camera.motion: static (background median-stable; only the cat changes between frames)
camera.background: plain white; no ground, horizon or shadows visible
camera.perspective: mild: loungers are seen slightly from above in two rows (back row tops y~714, front row tops y~734; back-row legs end y~856-870, front-row legs y~900). The cat's apparent size is constant over the clip (length ~107 px, height ~76 px), so it moves at constant depth, parallel to the image plane. Treat as one planar scale.

cat.description: black-and-white cat (black body and tail, white head/face and paws), the only moving object; walks left to right in front of (closer to the camera than) the front row of loungers
cat.occluded: never; it passes in front of the front-left lounger's left leg at frames ~27-30 and ~45-49
cat.reference_point: mask centroid (ref_x, ref_y) as proxy for the animal's origin/pelvis-body centre; bbox centre also given

size_px.note: length = horizontal bbox width, nose to back of tail base/tail; height = tail tip/ears to paws; varies with gait and tail pose

lounger_front_left.description: pink-brown wooden sun lounger, front row, left (cat walks in front of it at the end)

lounger_front_middle.description: same lounger model, front row, middle

lounger_front_right.description: same lounger model, front row, right (rightmost object)
lounger_front_right.note: seat slopes out to the right so its bbox is wider than its leg span

lounger_back_left.description: same lounger model, back row, left (leftmost lounger; right part hidden behind front-left)

lounger_back_middle.description: back row, middle, mostly hidden behind front loungers and the blue object; only its top (y~714) visible

blue_object.description: dark-blue/steel-blue soft object (cushion/bag-like) behind the loungers, top centre: a taller rounded block on the left plus a lower elongated part on the right
blue_object.note: bottom hidden behind the back/front loungers

dark_object.description: small dark grey round item (pot/stool/base) visible in the gap between front-left and front-middle loungers

events.note: already walking at frame 0 and still walking at frame 49; steady rightward pace (~5.4 px/frame, first half 5.5, second half 5.3); vertical centroid oscillates 884-892 px with the gait

events.event: cat head reaches front-left lounger's left leg (passes in front of it)
